runtime.os_target: Windows 10 x64 with WOW64; hard API minimum version 1703/build 15063. Steam is an independent external prerequisite; no complete 32-bit-Windows Steam workflow claim.

runtime.pdb: No CodeView PDB identity in the four delivery images; matching Release symbols unavailable. Separate local status records by binary SHA; no Debug PDB substitution.

checks.sandbox_note: Native launcher offline UI initially exited 2 under restricted sandbox. Identical immutable binaries passed outside sandbox under ordinary Windows API access. No production fix or security setting change was made.

limitations: Launcher --offline-ui-check bypasses settings load/save; child environment overrides do not redirect SHGetKnownFolderPath into a real new profile.
Native launcher button launching child/helper is source-audited; extracted binaries and helper fake-child contracts were dynamically tested directly.
Unchanged launcher has legacy initial D:\DEV paths. README requires selecting the user's own Half-Life directory and official x86 steam_api.dll before connecting. No old user settings were copied.
No new Steam, gameplay, hardware performance, unsupported GPU, or Windows 10 runtime test was performed.

reproduce.scope: Developer-side PowerShell 7 tooling only; no scripts or development tools needed by the shipped native launcher.
